div.p: Web Scheduled Orders

article.p: Scheduled Orders offer the convenience of purchasing large product quantities at one time, up to 12 months in advance. Doing so gives you the benefit of larger quantity price breaks based on your total order quantity. Plus, Mouser handles the planning to ensure your requested delivery schedule is met.
Additional benefits of scheduled orders include:

ul.li: Save time by placing your order now and eliminate administrative work later.
No more worrying about items not being in stock when you need them.
Order all of the products that you use regularly, and save.

article.p: Baskets meeting scheduling requirements will display a Schedule icon in the basket toolbar near the top of the page. Clicking this button will direct you from the Shopping Basket page to the Schedule Order page.

ul.li: Scheduled items feature a line number and item image.
Basket items with errors will not appear on the list of scheduled items.

article.p: In order to place an online scheduled order with Mouser, several conditions must be met. You must be logged in and the merchandise total must meet the minimum order requirement.

ul.li: Requested delivery dates cannot exceed one year from the order date.
Requested delivery dates cannot fall on a weekend.
Quantities must meet published minimums and multiples.
Immediate and scheduled shipments can be combined.

article.p: The total order quantity will default to shipping immediately. As your delivery dates and quantities are added, your immediate quantity will automatically be reduced.

ul.li: Use Add Shipment to add delivery dates.
Choose multiple items with the same delivery date using selected items.
Click Save Schedule when finished.

article.p: Your scheduled order detail page can also be exported as an Excel or PDF file.

Checking out with a scheduled order is similar to the standard online checkout process. You will proceed through address, shipping and payment screens, then review your order and delivery schedule before submitting.
Shipping costs and taxes for future scheduled deliveries are calculated and charged at the time of shipment.
Scheduled orders appear in Order History along with standard web orders, scheduled order bases, and scheduled shipments. Released shipments show a suffix such as S1, S2, etc.
You can edit your requested delivery schedule online from Order History. Delivery dates and quantities can be updated while unscheduled quantities switch to Ships Immediately.

p.strong: This privacy policy was last modified on 7 November 2023.

div.p: At Mouser, looking after the personal data you share with us is extremely important.

We appreciate your interest in our websites, services and products (collectively, our “Services”). Privacy protection is very important to us and we are committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This privacy policy sets out information about how we collect, store, process, transfer and use data that identifies you or makes you identifiable, as a natural person (hereinafter "personal information"). Personal information encompasses all personal data as defined in Art. 4 para 1 of the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and as defined by the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”).
We want you to be confident that your data is safe and secure with us, and understand how we use it to offer you a better, more personalised shopping experience.
The data controller is Mouser Electronics, Inc. (referred to in this policy as “Mouser”, “we” or “us”). We are responsible for, and control, the processing of your personal information.

Mouser is committed to doing the right thing when it comes to how we collect, use and protect information that identifies or is associated with you as a real person (“personal data”). This is why we have developed this privacy and cookie policy (“policy”), which:

ul.li: Outlines the types of personal data that we collect;
Explains how and why we collect and use your personal data;
Explains why and when we will share personal data within Mouser Electronics and with other organisations (suppliers and manufacturers); and
Explains the rights and choices you have when it comes to your personal data.

div.p: We offer a wide range of products and services, so we want to clearly explain what this policy covers. This policy applies to our websites, including www.mouser.com, and our mobile apps for iOS or Android mobile devices (collectively, our “services”). Using our services means: this policy also applies when you shop with us over the phone, and also if you contact us or any time we contact you about our services.
We may collect information such as your name, contact details, account details, order history, preferences, device data and communication records.

summary.span: How We Use and Share Your Personal Data

div.p: We use personal data to provide services, process orders, improve our website, send communications, prevent fraud, and comply with legal requirements.
You may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to certain processing of your personal data, depending on applicable laws.

summary.span: Retention and Protection of your Data

div.p: We keep data only as long as needed and use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect it.
Your information may be transferred internationally where Mouser and its service providers operate.

summary.span: Third Party Analytics and Online Advertising

div.p: We may use analytics and advertising partners to help understand usage and improve our services.
Our services are not directed to children and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

summary.span: Links to Other Websites and Services

div.p: Our site may link to other websites that have their own privacy practices.
You can contact Mouser for questions about privacy and data protection.
We may update this policy and post the updated version on this page.
This section provides additional information for California residents where applicable.
